# Acme Search Platform Overview

Acme Search is a fully-local retrieval system. It answers questions grounded in
your own documents and never sends data to a third party.

## Getting Started

Install the platform, point it at a document folder, and run the indexer. The
system parses, chunks, and embeds each document so it can be retrieved later.

## Support

For help, file a ticket referencing your deployment id.
